Events Full Reference (Events Data Dictionary) | Events | Event Investigation | Documentation | Support and resources | Falcon
https://falcon.us-2.crowdstrike.com/documentation/page/e3ce0b24/events-data-dictionary
1204/1226
Field Name
Field Description
Note: While these descriptions are robust and drive a helpful console experience, we encourage
you to not use this field to drive workflows, as values are updated and added regularly.
Tactic
Name of the tactic associated to the behavior.
TacticId
ID of the tactic associated to the behavior.
Technique
Name of the technique/sub-technique associated to the behavior.
TechniqueId
ID of the technique/sub-technique associated to the behavior.
Objective
Objective associated to the detection.
Severity
Severity of the detection.
Severities are: 10 (Informational), 20 - 30 (Low), 40 - 50 (Medium), 60 - 70 (High), 80 - 90
(Critical).
FalconHostLink
Link to view the detection event in the Falcon console.
ApplicationName
The name of the application seen during the event.
NetworkDetectionType
Action taken on the network connection (such as detected or prevented)
ProcessId
UPID of the process that generated the detection.
SELinuxEnforcementPolicy
State of SELinux enforcement policy on an Android device.
SafetyNetErrors
Describes a SafetyNet error. The error could have multiple reasons. Values:
PARSE_ERROR (1)
PROFILE_MATCH_FAILED (2)
BASIC_INTEGRITY_FAILED (3)
NONCE_INVALID (4)
APK_PACKAGE_NAME_INVALID (5)
APK_CERTIFICATE_INVALID (7)
SIGNATURE_INVALID (10)
CERTIFICATE_INVALID (11)
SafetyNetCTSProfileMatch
The result of a stricter verdict for device integrity. Returned by Google SafetyNet Attestation
API.
SafetyNetBasicIntegrity
The result of a more lenient verdict for device integrity. Returned by Google SafetyNet
Attestation API.
SafetyNetEvaluationType
Provides information about the type of measurements used to compute fields like
CTSProfileMatch and BasicIntegrity. Values:
Basic (0)
Hardware (1)
SafetyNetErrorMessage
An encoded error message. Returned by Google SafetyNet Attestation API.
SafetyNetAdvice
Provides information to help explain why the Google SafetyNet Attestation API set either
CTSProfileMatch or BasicIntegrity fields to false.

Field Name
Field Description
KeyStoreErrors
Describes a KeyStore error. The error could have multiple reasons. Values:
PARSE_ERROR (1)
CERTIFICATE_INVALID (2)
ROOT_KEY_INVALID (3)
NONCE_INVALID (4)
CERTIFICATE_REVOKED (5)
VerifiedBootState
Provides the device’s current boot state. Values:
VERIFIED (0)
SELF_VERIFIED (1)
UNVERIFIED (2)
FAILED (3)
PlayIntegrityMeetsBasicIntegrity
The result of a more lenient verdict for device integrity. Returned by Google Play Integrity
Attestation API.
PlayIntegrityMeetsDeviceIntegrity
The result of a stricter verdict for device integrity. Returned by Google Play Integrity Attestation
API.
PlayIntegrityMeetsStrongIntegrity
The result of a very stricter verdict for device integrity. Returned by Google Play Integrity
Attestation API.
PlayIntegrityErrorList
Describes a Play Integrity error. The error could have multiple reasons. Values:
PLAY_INTEGRITY_DECODING_ERROR (1)
PLAY_INTEGRITY_MARSHAL_ERROR (2)
PLAY_INTEGRITY_INVALID_NONCE (3)
PLAY_INTEGRITY_REQUEST_PACKAGE_NAME_INVALID (4)
PLAY_INTEGRITY_APK_PACKAGE_NAME_INVALID (5)
PLAY_INTEGRITY_TIMESTAMP_EXPIRED (6)
PLAY_INTEGRITY_APK_CERTIFICATE_SHA_INVALID (7)
PLAY_INTEGRITY_NO_DEVICE_INTEGRITY (8)
PLAY_INTEGRITY_ONLY_BASIC_INTEGRITY (9)
PLAY_INTEGRITY_PARTIAL_INTEGRITY (10)
PLAY_INTEGRITY_UNEVALUATED_APP_INTEGRITY (11)
PLAY_INTEGRITY_UNRECOGNIZED_APP_VERSION (12)

1206/1226
Field Name
Field Description
IntrusiveProperties\{\}.PropertyValue
Property value of the Android system property used in targeted intrusions.
TargetFileName
Name of the archive analyzed during forensic analysis.
MobileAppsDetails{}.ApkFileHashes
Comma-separated SHA-256 hash values of the APK files that make up an uncontainerized
Android application. If an application is containerized, this field is empty.
MobileAppsDetails{}.AppIdentifier
Package name of the Android application. Example: com.microsoft.office.outlook
MobileAppsDetails{}.AndroidAppLabel
Label name of the Android application. Example: Outlook
MobileAppsDetails{}.DexFileHashes
Comma-separated SHA-256 hash values of the dex files found in an Android application.
MobileAppsDetails{}.ImageFileName
Path to the base APK of the Android application.
MobileAppsDetails{}.AppInstallerInformation
Installer information of the Android application. Example: com.android.vending
MobileAppsDetails{}.IsBeingDebugged
True if the Android application is being debugged.
MobileAppsDetails{}.SharedObjectFileHashes
Comma-separated SHA-256 hash values of shared object files found inside an Android
application.
MobileAppsDetails{}.AndroidAppVersionName
Name of the Android application's version.Example: 4.2209.0
MobileAppsDetails{}.HarmfulAppCategory
HarmfulApp Category as defined by the Google SafetyNet API.
MobileAppsDetails{}.IsContainerized
True if the Android application is running inside the Falcon container.
MobileAppsDetails{}.AndroidComponentName
Identifier for a specific Android application component.
MobileAppsDetails{}.SHA256HashData
SHA256 of the Android application's APK file.
MobileAppsDetails{}.MaliciousDexSHA256Hashes
The list of an Android application’s malicious dex sha256 hashes.
MobileAppsDetails{}.MaliciousAPKSHA256Hashes
The list of an Android application’s malicious APK sha256 hashes.
MobileNetworkConnections{}.AccessTimestamp
Time when the network connection occurred in Unix Epoch time.
MobileNetworkConnections{}.Protocol
RFC-1700 IP protocol identifier.
MobileNetworkConnections{}.ConnectionFlags
Bitwise flags of socket attributes.
MobileNetworkConnections{}.LocalAddress
Local IP address.
MobileNetworkConnections{}.RemoteAddress
Remote IP address.
MobileNetworkConnections{}.LocalPort
Local port of a network connection.
MobileNetworkConnections{}.RemotePort
Remote port of a network connection.
MobileNetworkConnections{}.ConnectionDirection
Direction of the network connection. Examples: inbound (1), outbound (0), or neither (2).
MobileNetworkConnections{}.Url
Originating URL of the network connection.
MobileNetworkConnections{}.AppIdentifier
Package name of the Android application that triggered the network connection.
MobileNetworkConnections{}.IsAndroidAppContainerized
True if the Android application that triggered the network connection is containerized.

Field Name
Field Description
MobileNetworkConnections{}.IsIPV6
True if the network access is IPv6.
MobileNetworkConnections{}.ContextProcessId
UPID of the process that generated the network connection.
MobileDnsRequests{}.AccessTimestamp
Time when the DNS request activity occurred in Unix epoch time.
MobileDnsRequests{}.DomainName
Name of the domain in the DNS request.
MobileDnsRequests{}.RequestType
Type of the DNS request. For more information on DNS request types, see DNS Constants in the
documentation for Microsoft Developer Network.
MobileDnsRequests{}.AppIdentifier
Package name of the Android application that triggered the DNS request.
MobileDnsRequests{}.IpAddress
IP address that the Domain name resolved to.
MobileDnsRequests{}.ContextProcessId
UPID of the process that generated the DNS request.
MountedVolumes{}.Type
Type of the file system volume.
MountedVolumes{}.MountPoint
Mount point of the file system volume.
MountedVolumes{}.MountFlags
Bitwise flags of the mounted volume as defined by sys/mount.h for Unix platforms.
MountedVolumes{}.RealDeviceName
Name of the storage device associated with the volume.
Trampolines{}.FunctionName
Name of the function that was tampered for the trampoline.
Trampolines{}.ExecutableBytes
Contains the first 4 words of the tampered-with function where the trampoline was detected.
Trampolines{}.ImageFileName
Path to the image where the trampoline jumps to.
LoadedObjects{}.FileName
Path to the loaded object.
LoadedObjects{}.SHA256HashData
SHA256 of the loaded object.
LoadedObjects{}.CodeSigningFlags
Code signing flags of an application as defined by Apple codesigning.
ObjectiveCRuntimesAltered{}.MethodSignature
Indicates which Obj-C method has been tampered with. Example: [NSFileManager
fileExistsAtPath:]
ObjectiveCRuntimesAltered{}.ImageFileName
Path to the image containing the new implementation of the method.
ObjectiveCRuntimesAltered{}.ExpectedImageFileName
Path where the image was expected, if the path in ImageFileName represents an unexpected or
invalid one.
ObjectiveCRuntimesAltered{}.SuspectAddress
Load address of ImageFileName.
ObjectiveCRuntimesAltered{}.ExpectedAddress
Load address of ExpectedImageFileName.
RootAccessIndicators{}.LogcatMessage
Log message originating from a suspicious source.
RootAccessIndicators{}.AndroidStackTrace
Stack trace that triggered the detection.
RootAccessIndicators{}.HookedFunctionName
Name of the function that was hooked.
RootAccessIndicators{}.AndroidInitServiceName
Name of the Android init service added to the system configuration.
Certificates{}.Name
Name of the certificate.
